title: Gen115 intraday ideas that have a CFD twin, run first on Dukascopy CFDs at CFD costs (Databento futures run later as replication)
registered: 2026-10-19, before any Gen117 number was computed
data: research_data/dukascopy/*_1h.parquet (UTC bar-start labels), 2013-2026-09; New York times via tz conversion

tests.X1 bond-equity lead (=U4): sign of USTBOND 09:00-10:00 ET bar -> US500 position of the OPPOSITE sign, size 1, for the 10:00-15:00 ET bars (flat at 16:00)
tests.X2 EIA crude day (=U1): Wednesdays: sign of WTI 10:00-11:00 ET bar -> same sign, size 1, for 11:00-14:00 ET bars
tests.X3 FX month-end fix (=U7): last weekday of the month: if US500 month-to-date return (to the 09:00 ET bar close) > 0 -> sell USD (long EURUSD GBPUSD AUDUSD, short USDJPY, 0.25 each) else the reverse, for 10:00-11:00 ET bars
tests.X4 overnight-intraday reversal (=U3): US500 and US100: sign of 18:00 (previous day) -> 09:00 ET return -> opposite sign 0.5 each for 10:00-15:00 ET bars

rule: stand-alone: DEV 2013-2018 > 0, TEST 2019-2022 >= 0.5, HOLD 2023-2026/09 >= 0.3 net; passers then go into the bf book under the standard book rule (2022-26 Sharpe up, TEST and HOLD not lower)
